Coram : A.S. BOPANNA*, PAMIDIGHANTAM SRI NARASIMHA
Companies Act, 2013 : s. 59 – Rectification of register of members – Scope of Rectificatory jurisdiction of National Company Law tribunal-NCLT – Violation of – On facts, respondent No.1 acquired shares of the appellant exceeding 5% of its total shares from and failed to make disclosure as per Reg.7(1) of SAST Regulations and Reg. 13 of PIT Regulations – Appellant filed petition before NCLT u/s 111A of the 1956 Act (now s. 59 of the 2013 Act) for rectification of members register by deleting the name of the respondents as the owners of shares
Decision Date : 04-01-2023 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 2030/2019 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
